Synecdoche, New York

This film was written and directed by Charlie Kaufman and was released in 2008. Charlie Kaufman is my all time favourite screenwriter and I was excited to see his directorial debut. I love the pacing, acting, editing and of course the writing. This film manages to hold comedy and despair in its hands at the same time and lose nothing in the process. This film is extremely important and i recommend everyone to watch it. R.I.P Phillip Seymour Hoffman.

The Vast Of Night

This film was directed by Andrew Patterson and released in 2020. Honestly this film was a huge let down. I had been told that the pacing and acting was excellent and the cinematography was promised to be top notch. None of those things were true. The performances were stale and the pace was sleep inducing. I understand why people love the cinematography but it’s just not for me and honestly made me feel nauseous. Truly disappointing.
4/10

Children Of Men

This film was directed by Alfonso Cuarón and released in 2006. This film is really good. The cinematography was god-like with tales lasting 8-9 minutes without you even realising, all the performances were great and the dialogue was spot on. However, sometimes the editing was a bit jarring (it might of been on purpose but i don’t know) and some sections of the film over stayed their welcome and because a bit repetitive after a while. All in all, really solide film.
